preamble: Editorial still-life photography on a seamless warm off-white cyclorama. Large soft overhead source, huge white bounce, near-shadowless with one soft contact shadow. High key, gentle contrast, warm white and pale neutral grade. Medium-format sharpness, fine grain. Photographic realism, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: A beautifully decorated celebration cake: a two-tier round sponge cake frosted in smooth pale cream buttercream, decorated with fresh red berries (raspberries, redcurrants) and a few small pink flowers cascading down one side, standing on a light wooden cake stand on a light wooden table in a bright bakery studio, seen straight on at table height. Soft daylight from a large window on the right, warm gentle highlights on the frosting and berries; rich, saturated, appetising colour. The cake fills the right half of the frame from the table almost to the top edge; the left half of the frame is a clean, empty, softly lit warm off-white wall for text. No people, no hands, no text, no lettering on the cake, no plates or cutlery in the background, no logos, no watermark.
